description: The ALB spec documents no 404 on DeleteLoadBalancer, but the API returns 404 for a load balancer that does not exist: STACKIT's own Terraform provider (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/alb/applicationloadbalancer/resource.go, Delete, read 2026-11-01) treats http.StatusNotFound as already deleted. Type it as the model's NotFound so callers can tell a missing load balancer from other failures.
